correctness.rationale: Equations (1)–(3) reconstruct the conditional-depth martingale and exact indicator covariance, with all indices and normalizations. Absolute convergence and Cesàro correction are checked separately for summable and nonsummable weights. Strict monotonicity of p_j gives signs, tail sums give three leading constants; alpha=1 harmonic identity is a special case. Actual verify.py passes 100 independent exhaustive exact rational covariances plus 104 deterministic auxiliary tests. Finite checks are not treated as proof.

value.rationale: Connects a natural local outdegree with the global average search cost on the same weighted recursive tree. Identifies a qualitatively new sign reversal exactly at the non-summability boundary, a complete parameter-dependent covariance formula, three distinct asymptotic label scales, and an exact alpha=1 harmonic profile. These are motivated structural statistics rather than arbitrary parameter slices.
